snippet.title: 7er Pinball - Atari 8-bit Gameplay
snippet.description:
Gameplay captured from The400 Mini.

Made using the Atari 8-bit version of "Pinball Construction Set", there is not much known information about 7er Pinball, other than the fact it was released in 1984 and supposedly came from Germany.
